description: register_protocol_impl_providers resolves a defimpl's protocol/target against the enclosing scope's namespace at the point of the child defmodule. For deeply nested modules that re-declare or alias a protocol locally, that namespace is an approximation. Resolve each defimpl against its own lexical module's namespace for correctness in those cases.
title: Namespace-accurate protocol-impl resolution for aliased/local refs in nested scopes
